shots.text: I ran home faster than any ant has ever run. My legs were a blur.
I screamed it through every tunnel: they're coming.
A soldier {impact}pushed me into the dirt and said, "Go carry your crumbs, 250."
So I went to the one ant I thought would listen. Captain Vask, head of the gate guard.
shots.note: Captain Vask at the gate, 250 small before him.

shots.text: He listened to every word. He nodded. He told me he'd handle it.
Then he walked to the outer gate... and {impact}opened it.
shots.note: Vask opens the outer gate; fire beyond.

shots.text: I smelled it before I saw it: fire ant scent, all over him. He'd been working for them the whole time.
shots.note: Close on Vask: orange fire-ant scent all over him.

shots.text: By sunrise the walls were burning.
I {snap}snapped through twelve of them, then {snap}twenty, until my jaws ached and the tunnels were slick with venom.
It didn't matter. There were too many.
Our queen was dragged out in chains, screaming my colony's name...
and Vask stood beside the fire general, smiling.
